data.name: Choi
data.detailed_description:
Enter Choi’s Adventure

Play as Choi in this VR action-adventurer. Fight using button combos, then switch to first-person VR interaction to manage your inventory. Defeat monsters, loot gear, customize your character, and grow stronger to face tougher enemies. All from the comfort of your couch.

Built for VR Immersion

Choi takes full advantage of VR, allowing you to interact naturally by touching objects and connecting directly with your character, creating a more intimate and immersive experience.

Classic Gameplay, Couch Comfort

Enjoy traditional third-person gameplay with familiar controller-based movement and combat, letting you play the way you know best. Designed for seated VR, it delivers a comfortable couch-friendly experience without sacrificing immersion.
